semanticChecks.scope: Owner AI translated all seven sections / 42 distinct paragraphs, seven lesson metadata records / 14 objectives / seven art captions, seven questions / 28 options / 28 specific rationales and seven complete effective case readings directly from Japanese. Full source comparison and continuous Hindi prose, metadata, question and reading self-review completed. No other target language, pivot or semantic cross-review used.
semanticChecks.multidisciplinaryHandoff: Person wishes, actual observed problems and questions drive consultation. PT basic movement, OT daily activities and ST language/communication/swallowing roles retained without claiming one profession solves every problem. Actual accomplished and difficult parts distinguished. Sending, receiving, confirming advice and changing plan remain separate; clarify who supports and permitted changes before acting. Necessary information only to necessary recipients; no independent diagnosis, rehabilitation exercise design or report-only food texture/drink changes. Kai case unknown cause/new plan in reading and not-yet-diagnosed speech difficulty in paragraph preserved separately.
semanticChecks.observationAndRecordCorrection: Person words/feelings, observed acts and measured values remain distinct, with 14:00 and two interruptions retained. Room-temperature measurement, worker hot impression and person temperature are not equivalent. No measured values invented; unseen duration and unknown cause stay unconfirmed. Near miss and no injury do not remove risk. Unsupported fever/room-heat conclusion corrected using facility method with visible correction history, changes reported to responsible person. Urgent help/contact not delayed until wording perfected; no numeric diagnosis/procedure thresholds invented.
semanticChecks.handHygieneCompletion: Visible dirt and prior/next contact guide method rather than convenience. Running water and soap versus alcohol rub distinct. Both hands, palms/backs/interdigital/thumb/tips/nails, facility jewelry rules, rinsing and drying preserved; no count-alone proof. Specified amount/method and rubbing until dry retained, no premature wiping. Subsequent dirty towel/surface may recontaminate; gloves never replace hand hygiene. Infection policy, product instructions and workplace training govern quantity/time/product/pathogen choices. Specific reading next clean-supply container and colleague proposals translated fully without inventing a second colleague.
semanticChecks.workerCapacityAndEquipment: Posture is only one condition alongside person ability, place, equipment, number of helpers and role allocation. Own back pain/fatigue and training gap reported to responsible person, both worker and recipient risk retained as possibility. Equipment presence is not model competence or joint readiness. Lift/sliding sheet selected to person/task, checked before use and used by trained method. Full-assistance lifting considers alternatives to manual lifting. No text-only lifting/pulling/moving/body fulcrum technique; individual assessment and workplace training required, unclear method not tried alone.
semanticChecks.disasterFollowThrough: Complete bag distinct from usable route, communication, accepted support role and accessible information actually reaching person who needs it. Attendance is not successful completion. Unreachable staff and trolley obstruction remain unfinished items, role-list name not acceptance of current response. Facility plan governs owner, report recipient and effect recheck; no invented substitute or route. Assignment, corrective action and confirmed effect remain separate. No universal earthquake/fire/storm/flood evacuation sequence, actual trained facility response/instructions prevail and action not delayed for practice report.
semanticChecks.feelingsAndParticipation: Expression/silence invite non-leading questions, not sadness/anger/refusal diagnosis. Activity wish distinct from participation barriers; noise/hunger/fatigue/anxiety can coexist, no single guessed cause for every response. Meaningful choice of participation, song/topic/time/company and actual conditions consulted. Activity count or staff praise not satisfaction proof. Alone-listening wish not rejection of future contact or song choice. Needs models/expression not psychological diagnosis or capacity test; continued trouble/changes reported concretely to necessary responsible staff according to individual plan.
semanticChecks.memoryAndInformationAccess: Established encoding, retention, recall and semantic/episodic/procedural memory terms retained. Familiar skill does not prove new schedule was heard/remembered or all memory normal. Hearing/access, understanding content/question and task-specific response checked before attributing difficulty to memory. Noise remains a condition to check, not confirmed cause. Observed skill/person answer/explanation setting/unknowns separated; suitable concise explanation/quiet space/usable communication consulted. Single forgetting is not disease diagnosis and skill is not global normality guarantee; no dementia test or decisional-capacity substitute.
semanticChecks.readingsCaptionsRegister: All seven readingJa fields are nonempty and all seven complete effective authored case readings translated, including details that differ from section examples. No empty or absent readings invented. Actual source has zero figureCaptionsJa keys; all seven lesson art captions translated with image-evidence limitations. Respectful adult connected Hindi, no invented age/gender/kinship or procedural instructions. Prior preferred terminology/profile retained; no exact prior Japanese paragraph overlap or repeated paragraph within unit.
